testcase.name: a randomly chosen first team starts with the seat left of its midpoint, and turn order wraps the table (CR 808.4)
each player has their own life total; damaging one teammate doesn't touch the other (CR 808.5)
teammates have distinct life owners (no canonical pooling)
a player at 0 life loses ALONE; the teammate plays on and the game continues (CR 104.3b)
a team loses only once ALL its members are out; the other team wins together (CR 104.2c)
conceding eliminates only the conceding player; the teammate fights on (no 810.8a propagation)
a can't-lose grant protects only its controller, not the whole team (CR 808 / normal 104)
poison is per-player at threshold 10; one poisoned player loses alone
poison does NOT pool across the team — 8 + 7 = 15 kills no one (each is below 10)
opponents exclude teammates; teammates are recognised
turn ownership is individual: only the active player owns the turn; a teammate does not
each player draws on their own turn; no first-turn draw skip in a 4-player game (CR 103.8c)
the turn passes to the next individual player, not skipping the whole team
only the directly-attacked player defends; a teammate is not pulled in as a defender
